mn39:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu viharati assapuraṃ nāma aṅgānaṃ nigamo.
mn39:2.2: tumhe ca pana ke tumheti puṭṭhā samānā samaṇamhāti paṭi jānātha.
mn39:2.3: tesaṃ vo bhikkhave evaṃ samaññānaṃ sataṃ evampaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ “ye dhammā samaṇakaraṇā ca brāhmaṇakaraṇā ca te dhamme samādāya vattissāma. evaṃ no amhākaṃ samaññā ca ayaṃ saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā.
mn39:2.4: yesañca mayaṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paribhuñjāma. tesaṃ te kārā amhesu mahapphalā bhavissanti mahānisaṃsā. amhākañcevāyaṃ pabbajjā avañjhā bhavissati saphalā saudrayāti.”
mn39:3.1: katame ca bhikkhave dhammā samaṇakaraṇā ca brāhmaṇakaraṇā ca?
mn39:3.2: hirottappena samannāgatā bhavissāmāti evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ.
mn39:3.3: siyā kho pana bhikkhave tumhākaṃ eva massa:
mn39:3.4: hirottappenamhā samannāgatā. alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā. anuppatto no sāmaññattho natthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.
mn39:3.5: ārocayāmi vo bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo bhikkhave:
mn39:3.6: mā vo sāmaññatthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññattho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye.
mn39:4.2: ‘parisuddho no kāyasamācāro bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca.
mn39:4.3: tāya ca pana parisuddhakāyasamācāratāya nevattānukkaṃsissāma, na paraṃ vambhissāmā’ti evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ.
mn39:4.4: siyā kho pana bhikkhave tumhākaṃ evamassa:
mn39:4.6: alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā. anuppatto no sāmaññattho. natthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.
mn39:4.7: ārocayāmi vo bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo bhikkhave:
mn39:4.8: mā vo sāmaññatthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññattho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye.
mn39:5.2: ‘parisuddho no vacīsamācāro bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca.
mn39:5.3: tāya ca pana parisuddhavacīsamācāratāya nevattānukkaṃsissāma na paraṃ vambhissāmā’ti evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ.
mn39:5.4: siyā kho pana bhikkhave tumhākaṃ evamassa:
mn39:5.5: hirottappenamhā samannāgatā, parisuddho no kāyasamācāro, parisuddho vacīsamācāro.
mn39:5.6: alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā. anuppatto no sāmaññattho. natthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.
mn39:5.7: ārocayāmi vo bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo bhikkhave:
mn39:5.8: mā vo sāmaññatthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññattho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye.
mn39:6.2: ‘parisuddho no manosamācāro bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca.
mn39:6.3: tāya ca pana parisuddhamanosamācāratāya nevattānukkaṃsissāma, na paraṃ vambhissāmā’ti evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ.
mn39:6.4: siyā kho pana bhikkhave tumhākaṃ evamassa:
mn39:6.5: hirottappenamhā samannāgatā, parisuddho no kāyasamācāro, parisuddho vacīsamācāro, parisuddho manosamācāro.
mn39:6.6: alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā. anuppatto no sāmaññattho. natthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.
mn39:6.7: ārocayāmi vo bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo bhikkhave:
mn39:6.8: mā vo sāmaññatthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññattho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye.
mn39:7.2: ‘parisuddho no ājīvo bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca.
mn39:7.3: tāya ca pana parisuddhājīvatāya nevattānukkaṃsissāma, na paraṃ vambhissāmā’ti evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ.
mn39:7.4: siyā kho pana bhikkhave tumhākaṃ evamassa:
mn39:7.5: hirottappenamhā samannāgatā, parisuddho no kāyasamācāro, parisuddho vacīsamācāro, parisuddho manosamācāro, parisuddho ājīvo.
mn39:7.6: alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā. anuppatto no sāmaññattho. natthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.
mn39:7.7: ārocayāmi vo bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo bhikkhave:
mn39:7.8: mā vo sāmaññatthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññattho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye.
mn39:8.3: cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī nānubyañjanaggāhī.
mn39:8.4: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjissāma, rakkhissāma cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjissāma.
mn39:8.9: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī nānubyañjanaggāhī.
mn39:8.10: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjissāma, rakkhissāma manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjissāmā’ti evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ.
mn39:8.11: siyā kho pana bhikkhave tumhākaṃ evamassa:
mn39:8.12: hirottappenamhā samannāgatā, parisuddho no kāyasamācāro, parisuddho vacīsamācāro, parisuddho manosamācāro, parisuddho ājīvo. indriyesumhā guttadvārā.
mn39:8.13: alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā. anuppatto no sāmaññattho. natthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.
mn39:8.14: ārocayāmi vo bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo bhikkhave:
mn39:8.15: mā vo sāmaññatthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññattho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye.
mn39:9.2: ‘bhojane mattaññuno bhavissāma. paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma:
mn39:9.3: ‘neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya. iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi. yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihārocā’ti evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ.
mn39:9.4: siyā kho pana bhikkhave tumhākaṃ evamassa:
mn39:9.5: hirottappenamhā samannāgatā, parisuddho no kāyasamācāro, parisuddho vacīsamācāro, parisuddho manosamācāro, parisuddho ājīvo, indriyesumhā guttadvārā, bhojane mattaññuno.
mn39:9.6: alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā. anuppatto no sāmaññattho. natthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.
mn39:9.7: ārocayāmi vo bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo bhikkhave:
mn39:9.8: mā vo sāmaññatthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññattho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye.
mn39:10.2: jāgariyaṃ anuyuttā bhavissāma: divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhessāma,
mn39:10.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhessāma.
mn39:10.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappessāma pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajānā uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā,
mn39:10.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhessāmāti evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ.
mn39:10.6: siyā kho pana bhikkhave, tumhākaṃ evamassa:
mn39:10.7: hirottappenamhā samannāgatā, parisuddho no kāyasamācāro, parisuddho vacīsamācāro, parisuddho manosamācāro, parisuddho ājīvo, indriyesumhā guttadvārā, bhojane mattaññuno, jāgariyā anuyuttā.
mn39:10.8: alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā. anuppatto no sāmaññattho. natthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.
mn39:10.9: ārocayāmi vo bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo bhikkhave:
mn39:10.10: mā vo sāmaññatthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññattho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye.
mn39:11.2: satisampajaññena samannāgatā bhavissāma: abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī, sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī, asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārīti evañhi hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ.
mn39:11.3: siyā kho pana bhikkhave tumhākaṃ evamassa:
mn39:11.4: hirottappenamhā samannāgatā, parisuddho no kāyasamācāro, parisuddho vacīsamācāro, parisuddho manosamācāro, parisuddho ājīvo, indriyesumhā guttadvārā, bhojane mattaññuno, jāgariyaṃ anuyuttā, satisampajaññena samannāgatā.
mn39:11.5: alamettāvatā, katamettāvatā. anuppatto no sāmaññattho. natthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyanti tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.
mn39:11.6: ārocayāmi vo bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo bhikkhave:
mn39:11.7: mā vo sāmaññatthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññattho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye.
mn39:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati: araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn39:13.1: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya, parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn39:13.2: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati. abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn39:13.3: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī. byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn39:13.4: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno. thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn39:13.5: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto. uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn39:13.6: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṅkathī kusalesu dhammesu. vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn39:14.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso iṇaṃ ādāya kammante payojeyya,
mn39:14.3: so yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni tāni ca byantīkareyya, siyā cassa uttariṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ dārābharaṇāya,
mn39:14.5: “ahaṃ kho pubbe iṇaṃ ādāya kammante payojesiṃ. tassa me kammantā samijjhiṃsu.
mn39:14.6: so ahaṃ yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni, tāni ca byantīakāsiṃ. atthī ca me uttariṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ dārābhāraṇāyā”ti.
mn39:14.7: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmujjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ –
mn39:14.8: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso ābādhiko assa dukkhito bāḷhagilāno, bhattañcassa nacchādeyya, na cassa kāye balamattā,
mn39:14.9: so aparena samayena tamhā ābādhā mucceyya, bhattañcassa chādeyya, siyā cassa kāye balamattā,
mn39:14.11: “ahaṃ kho pubbe ābādhiko ahosiṃ dukkhito bāḷhagilāno. bhattañca me nacchādesi. na ca me āsi kāye balamattā. somhi etarahi tamhā ābādhā mutto bhattañca me chādeti. atthi ca me kāye balamattāti.”
mn39:14.12: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmujjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ –
mn39:14.13: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso bandhanāgāre baddho assa,
mn39:14.14: so aparena samayena tamhā bandhanā mucceyya sotthinā abyayena na cassa koci bhogānaṃ vayo,
mn39:14.16: “ahaṃ kho pubbe bandhanāgāre baddho ahosiṃ. somhi etarahi tamhā bandhanā mutto sotthinā abyayena. natthi ca me koci bhogānaṃ vayo”ti.
mn39:14.17: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmujjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
mn39:14.18: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso dāso assa anattādhīno parādhīno na yenakāmaṅgamo.
mn39:14.19: so aparena samayena tamhā dāsavyā mucceyya attādhīno aparādhīno bhujisso yena kāmaṅgamo.
mn39:14.21: ahaṃ kho pubbe dāso ahosiṃ anattādhīno parādhīno na yenakāmaṅgamo, somhi etarahi tamhā dāsavyā mutto attādhīno aparādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṅgamoti.
mn39:14.22: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmujjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
mn39:14.23: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso sadhano sabhogo kantāraddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya,
mn39:14.24: so aparena samayena tamhā kantārā nitthareyya sotthinā abyayena, na cassa kiñci bhogānaṃ vayo.
mn39:14.26: ahaṃ kho pubbe sadhano sabhogo kantāraddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjiṃ.
mn39:14.27: somhi etarahi tamhā kantārā nitthiṇṇo sotthinā abyayena, natthi ca me kiñci bhogānaṃ vayoti.
mn39:14.28: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmujjaṃ, adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
mn39:14.29: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yathā iṇaṃ, yathārogaṃ, yathā bandhanāgāraṃ, yathā dāsavyaṃ, yathā kantāraddhānamaggaṃ, ime pañcanīvaraṇe appahīne attani samanupassati.
mn39:14.30: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ānaṇyaṃ yathā ārogyaṃ, yathā bandhanā mokkhaṃ, yathā bhujissaṃ, yathā khemantabhūmi, evameva bhikkhu ime pañcanīvaraṇe pahīne attani samanupassati.
mn39:15.1: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe,
mn39:15.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi, savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn39:15.3: so imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
mn39:15.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dakkho nahāpako vā nahāpakantevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nahānīyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya, sāssa nahānīyapiṇḍi snehānugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena na ca pagghariṇī.
mn39:15.5: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
mn39:16.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn39:16.2: so imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
mn39:16.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave udakarahado ubbhidodako. tassa nevassa puratthimāya disāya udakassāyamukhaṃ, na pacchimāya disāya udakassāyamukhaṃ, na uttarāya disāya udakassāyamukhaṃ, na dakkhiṇāya disāya udakassāyamukhaṃ. devo ca kālena kālaṃ sammā dhāraṃ nānuppaveccheyya. atha kho tamhāva udakarahadā sītā vāridhārā ubbhijjitvā tameva udakarahadaṃ sītena vārinā abhisandeyya parisandeyya paripūreyya paripphareyya, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato udakarahadassa sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa.
mn39:16.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
mn39:17.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti. yantaṃ ariyāācikkhanti: ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn39:17.2: so imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
mn39:17.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni, tāni yāva caggā yāva ca mūlā sītena vārinā abhisannāni parisannāni paripūrāni paripphuṭāni. na nesaṃ kiñci sabbāvataṃ uppalānaṃ vā padumānaṃ vā puṇḍarīkānaṃ vā sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa.
mn39:17.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
mn39:18.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn39:18.2: so imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
mn39:18.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso odātena vatthena sasīsaṃ pārupitvā nisinno assa, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa odātena vatthena apphuṭaṃ assa.
mn39:18.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
mn39:19.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn39:19.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsatimpi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattārīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi, anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe ‘amutrāsiṃ evannāmo evaṅgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra upapādiṃ. tatrāpāsiṃ evannāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn39:19.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso sakamhā gāmā aññaṃ gāmaṃ gaccheyya, tamhāpi gāmā aññaṃ gāmaṃ gaccheyya, so tamhā gāmā sakaṃyeva gāmaṃ paccāgaccheyya, tassa evamassa: ‘ahaṃ kho sakamhā gāmā amuṃ gāmaṃ agañchiṃ tatra evaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ, evaṃ nisīdiṃ, evaṃ abhāsiṃ, evaṃ tuṇhī ahosiṃ. tamhāpi gāmā amuṃ gāmaṃ agañchiṃ. tatrāpi evaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ, evaṃ nisīdiṃ, evaṃ abhāsiṃ, evaṃ tuṇhī ahosiṃ. somhi tamhā gāmā sakaṃyeva gāmaṃ paccāgato’ti.
mn39:19.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn39:20.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn39:20.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati: cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate. yathākammūpage satte pajānāti: – “ime vata bhonto sattā kāya duccaritena samannāgatā vacī duccaritena samannāgatā mano duccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā. ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena
mn39:20.3: samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā”ti. iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti. seyyathāpassu bhikkhave dve agārā sadvārā, tattha cakkhumā puriso majjhe ṭhito passeyya manusse gehaṃ pavisantepi nikkhamantepi, anucaṅkamantepi anuvicarantepi.
mn39:20.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti …pe…
mn39:21.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti:
mn39:21.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
mn39:21.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
mn39:21.4: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati, bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati, avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
mn39:21.6: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn39:21.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave pabbatasaṅkhepe udakarahado accho vippasanno anāvilo,
mn39:21.8: tattha cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito passeyya sippisambukampi sakkharakaṭhalampi macchagumbampi carantampi tiṭṭhantampi,
mn39:21.10: ayaṃ kho udakarahado accho vippasanno anāvilo. tatrime sippisambukāpi sakkharakaṭhalāpi macchagumbāpi carantipi tiṭṭhantipī’ti.
mn39:21.11: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti. ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ,
mn39:22.1: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu samaṇo itipi brāhmaṇo itipi nahātako itipi, vedagū itipi, sottiyo itipi, ariyo itipi, arahaṃ itipi.
mn39:23.2: samitāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
mn39:23.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu samaṇo hoti.
mn39:24.2: bāhitāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
mn39:24.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu brāhmaṇo hoti.
mn39:25.2: nahātāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
mn39:25.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu nahātako hoti.
mn39:26.2: viditāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
mn39:26.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vedagū hoti.
mn39:27.2: nissutāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
mn39:27.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sottiyo hoti.
mn39:28.2: ārakāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
mn39:28.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo hoti.
mn39:29.2: ārakāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
mn39:29.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu arahaṃ hotīti.
mn39:29.5: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
